parameters.content:
## Workflow Responsibility
Normalizes and validates canonical leads, enforces idempotency, resolves identity, persists state, and hands only valid unique or safely merged leads to WF03. Enrichment, scoring, AI classification, routing, CRM sync, and follow-up are out of scope.

## Identity Rules

### Candidate Retrieval
`Find Identity Candidates` retrieves plausible matches using either:

- Exact normalized phone
- Exact normalized email
- Same normalized name with the existing lead received within ±2 minutes of the incoming lead

The ±2-minute retrieval window prevents an unbounded name-based search. Candidate retrieval does not make the final duplicate decision.

### Evaluate Identity Match
The downstream deterministic evaluator is the source of truth and classifies each candidate as Exact Duplicate, Likely Duplicate, or Unique.

Exact normalized phone OR exact normalized email, without serious conflicting identifiers, is an exact duplicate with confidence 1.0.

When no exact contact identifier matches, contextual signals are scored:

- Normalized name match: +0.3
- Company match: +0.2
- Different source: +0.1
- Arrival within 2 minutes: +0.2
- Same service interest: +0.1

Contextual confidence >= 0.6 routes a likely duplicate to Manual Review. Lower confidence is Unique.

Exact duplicates are conservatively merged into the existing canonical lead. Incoming duplicate submissions are preserved through `duplicate_decisions` and `lead_events`, not as additional canonical rows in `leads`.

## Manual Review
Incomplete, invalid, or ambiguous duplicate leads are never discarded. Their state, decision context, and audit events are stored for data completion or human review. Global retry and dead-letter handling remain the responsibility of WF07.

return [{ json: { status: 'manual_review', reason: 'incomplete_lead', lead_id: lead.lead_id ?? null } }];

const lead = $json.lead ?? {};
return [{ json: { status: 'already_processed', operation: 'lead_intake', lead_id: lead.lead_id ?? null, idempotency_key: lead.processing?.idempotency_key ?? null, response_reference: $json.response_reference ?? null } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key,operation,status,created_at,expires_at)
VALUES ($1,'lead_intake','processing',now(),now()+interval '30 days')
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET status=CASE WHEN idempotency_keys.status='completed' THEN idempotency_keys.status ELSE 'processing' END, expires_at=GREATEST(idempotency_keys.expires_at,EXCLUDED.expires_at)
RETURNING $2::jsonb AS lead;

SELECT
    $6::jsonb AS incoming_lead,
    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l))
            FILTER (WHERE l.id IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS candidates
FROM leads l
WHERE l.id <> $1::uuid
AND (
    (
        NULLIF($2, '') IS NOT NULL
        AND l.phone_normalized = NULLIF($2, '')
    )
    OR
    (
        NULLIF($3, '') IS NOT NULL
        AND l.email_normalized = NULLIF($3, '')
    )
    OR
    (
        NULLIF($4, '') IS NOT NULL
        AND lower(trim(l.name)) = lower(trim($4))
        AND l.received_at BETWEEN
            (
                ($6::jsonb #>> '{source,received_at}')::timestamptz
                - interval '2 minutes'
            )
            AND
            (
                ($6::jsonb #>> '{source,received_at}')::timestamptz
                + interval '2 minutes'
            )
    )
);

WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
merged AS (
 UPDATE leads SET
  name=COALESCE(leads.name,input.j#>>'{contact,name}'),
  phone_raw=COALESCE(leads.phone_raw,input.j#>>'{contact,phone_raw}'),
  phone_normalized=COALESCE(leads.phone_normalized,input.j#>>'{contact,phone_normalized}'),
  email_raw=COALESCE(leads.email_raw,input.j#>>'{contact,email_raw}'),
  email_normalized=COALESCE(leads.email_normalized,input.j#>>'{contact,email_normalized}'),
  company_name=COALESCE(leads.company_name,input.j#>>'{business,company_name}'),
  service_interest=COALESCE(leads.service_interest,input.j#>>'{business,service_interest}'),
  country=COALESCE(leads.country,input.j#>>'{business,country}'),
  industry=COALESCE(leads.industry,input.j#>>'{business,industry}'),
  company_size=COALESCE(leads.company_size,NULLIF(input.j#>>'{business,company_size}','')::integer),
  message=COALESCE(leads.message,input.j#>>'{request,message}'),
  consent=leads.consent OR COALESCE((input.j#>>'{contact,consent}')::boolean,false),
  strategic_account=leads.strategic_account OR COALESCE((input.j#>>'{business,strategic_account}')::boolean,false),
  identity_status='exact_duplicate',
  updated_at=now()
 FROM input
 WHERE leads.id=(input.j#>>'{identity,matched_lead_id}')::uuid
 RETURNING leads.id
), decision AS (
 INSERT INTO duplicate_decisions (candidate_lead_id,matched_lead_id,match_type,confidence,decision,reason,created_at)
 SELECT
  (j#>>'{duplicate_decision,candidate_lead_id}')::uuid,
  merged.id,
  j#>>'{duplicate_decision,match_type}',
  (j#>>'{duplicate_decision,confidence}')::numeric,
  j#>>'{duplicate_decision,decision}',
  j#>>'{duplicate_decision,reason}',
  COALESCE((j#>>'{duplicate_decision,created_at}')::timestamptz,now())
 FROM input,merged
), idem AS (
 UPDATE idempotency_keys
 SET lead_id=merged.id,status='completed',response_reference=merged.id::text
 FROM merged,input
 WHERE key=input.j#>>'{processing,idempotency_key}'
), history AS (
 INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at)
 SELECT merged.id,e->>'event_type','WF02_validation_identity',e->>'execution_id',COALESCE(e->'payload','{}'::jsonb),COALESCE((e->>'created_at')::timestamptz,now())
 FROM merged,input,LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(input.j->'audit_events','[]'::jsonb)) e
), merged_event AS (
 INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload,created_at)
 SELECT merged.id,'duplicate_merged','WF02_validation_identity',NULL,
  jsonb_build_object(
   'candidate_lead_id',input.j#>>'{duplicate_decision,candidate_lead_id}',
   'matched_lead_id',merged.id,
   'match_type',input.j#>>'{duplicate_decision,match_type}',
   'confidence',input.j#>>'{duplicate_decision,confidence}'
  ),now()
 FROM merged,input
)
SELECT input.j AS lead FROM input;
